entries.reason: This PR introduces the bootstrap gate itself. The PR Metadata Contract job materialises the body checker pinned at the base SHA so that a PR cannot adjudicate itself with its own edited gate; the base here has no scripts/lib/self-referential-bootstrap.ps1 and no gate wiring, so the base-pinned checker has no gate to run at all. Any PR that adds a gate has a base without that gate, so no ordering avoids this.
